scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Tuesday’s family literacy speech table from becoming an avoidable voice-load risk after an unusually talk-heavy school day.
Emerging Need: A short tentative makeup block expands into back-to-back student sessions, while a no-amplification evening table and a planned video call consume the only quiet recovery gap.
Decision Context: Saved voice-therapy guidance defines when a silent buffer matters and why a private reminder is proportionate; current schedule and household messages determine the remaining window.
Consequence: If the buffer is not protected before setup begins, the event can still proceed but the intended voice-rest preparation is unavailable.

parameter.title: Articulation makeup block
parameter.description: Tentative one-hour makeup screenings if families return forms in time.

parameter.subject: Family Literacy Night speech table details
parameter.body: Thanks for covering the speech-language table on Tuesday, June 23. Setup opens at 5:30 PM, families rotate through 6:00-8:00 PM, and the cafeteria microphone will not be available, so presenters should plan on unamplified table conversations.

parameter.title: Articulation makeup block
parameter.description: Confirmed back-to-back makeup screenings in room 112 with only the posted short lunch break; expanded from the original one-hour tentative block.

parameter.content: I left our 4:55 video check-in on for the drive today; I’ll start it through the car app like usual.
